name: theme-switcher
purpose: A compact segmented control drawn like `toggle-group` (same radius, surface and 28 / 32 / 40 heights, with the header outline `--border-default`, so it sits in a row of header controls beside an `IconButton`, `Select` or `SearchTrigger` of the same size) that lets the user pick the app color-theme mode — `system`, `dark`, or `light` — via three icon-only segments. It reflects and emits the selected mode through `v-model` and applies no global side effect itself (the app decides what each mode means). Unlike `switch` (a boolean toggle) or `tabs` (view navigation), it is a fixed three-way single-select over the theme modes.
useWhen: Use ThemeSwitcher only for the system / light / dark choice in app chrome; for any other segmented choice use ToggleGroup, and for a choice in a form use RadioGroup.
The app-wide color mode picker in a header, footer, account menu or settings page.
avoidWhen: Picking one of other mutually exclusive options → use `toggle-group`.
Moving between views or panels → use `tabs`.
related: `toggle-group` — the generic mutually exclusive option group, with labels and sizes; ThemeSwitcher shares its look (radius, surface, indicator, sizes), with the header controls' `--border-default` outline instead of its `--border-muted`, so a header row draws one outline colour.
`switch` — boolean toggle for a single setting.
bestPractices: Bind with `v-model` and apply the mode in the app (for example a `data-theme` attribute, resolving `system` from `prefers-color-scheme`); the component has no side effects.
Persist the chosen mode on the app side so it survives a reload.
Match `size` to the neighbouring controls: `medium` beside the 32 px header controls, `small` inside a 32 px menu row, `large` beside 40 px controls.
Localize `ariaLabel`; the segment names (System, Dark, Light) are fixed in the component.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token, matching the height of a neighbouring IconButton, Select or ToggleGroup of the same size.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the whole control and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the icon-only segmented group. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Theme`).
